column1: # NavSafe model-zoo evaluation matrix — the single source of truth for the sweep.
# row_slug   the output directory name under outputs/. One row of the benchmark
#            table, NOT a model_type: recogdrive/mtdrive/simwam each contribute
#            two rows that differ only by checkpoint.
# model_type the --model-type argument (a registered adapter name).
# ckpt       --checkpoint, relative to $NAVSAFE_ZOO (/avl-west/navsafe_eval/model_zoo).
#            "none" for the rule-based planners, which take no weights.
# Order is deliberate: drivor first because it is the one adapter already proven
# end to end on this cluster (navsafe_421/templates/webgif_eval.yaml), so a
# fleet-wide setup fault shows up on the row we can attribute it on.
# The eight subprocess-VLA rows (recogdrive x2, mtdrive x2, autovla, simwam x2,
# drivelaw) are NOT here: their NAVSAFE_VLA_PYTHON venv and the AutoVLA /
# DriveLaW / SimWAM upstream clones do not exist on any storage we mount. See
# README.md "What is not in this sweep".
# pdm_closed is not from the zoo and takes no weights by construction: it is the
# privileged rule-based proposal/score/select planner in
# nexussim/policy/state/pdm_closed.py, and it is here as the reference the
# learned rows are read against. (`pdm_closed_fast` and `pdm_closed_agentic` are
# registered beside it and are NOT this row.)
# transfuser and ego_status_mlp were dropped from the sweep on 2026-08-26. Cells
# already scored for them stay on disk under outputs/ — they cost nothing to keep
# and re-adding the rows here would pick them straight back up.
# row_slug          model_type       ckpt
drivor              drivor           drivor/drivor_Nav1_25epochs.pth
ltf                 ltf              ltf/ltf_seed_0.ckpt
diffusiondrive      diffusiondrive   diffusiondrive/diffusiondrive_navsim_88p1_PDMS
sparsedrivev2       sparsedrivev2    sparsedrivev2/sparsedrive_navsimv1_92p2.ckpt
pdm_closed          pdm_closed       none
